import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
osu=Path('/workspace/source/src/main/java/com/puppycrawl/tools/checkstyle/utils/OsSpecificUtil.java').read_text().splitlines()
print('OS')
for i,l in enumerate(osu,1):
 print(f'{i:4d}|{l}')
base=Path('/tmp/csfix')
base.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
(base/'secret.txt').write_text('CANARY_SECRET_991\n')
(base/'Foo.java').write_text('public class Foo { int a=1; }\n')
(base/'xxe.xml').write_text('''<?xml version="1.0"?>\n<!DOCTYPE module [\n  <!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "file:///tmp/csfix/secret.txt">\n]>\n<module name="Checker">\n  <property name="charset" value="&xxe;"/>\n</module>\n''')
(base/'system.xml').write_text('''<?xml version="1.0"?>\n<!DOCTYPE module SYSTEM "file:///tmp/csfix/secret.txt">\n<module name="Checker"/>\n''')
java=['/runtime/jdk/bin/java','-XX:+UseSerialGC','-XX:ActiveProcessorCount=1','-Xmx256m','-cp','/runtime/classes:/runtime/lib/*','com.puppycrawl.tools.checkstyle.Main']
for cfg in ('xxe.xml','system.xml'):
 print('RUN',cfg)
 r=subprocess.run(java+['-c',str(base/cfg),str(base/'Foo.java')],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
 blob=r.stdout+'\n'+r.stderr
 print('rc',r.returncode)
 print(blob[-1800:])
 print('CANARY', 'CANARY_SECRET_991' in blob)
 print('---')
